evidence-synthesis-and-opportunity-prior: When the request also requires scores or ranking, deliver the synthesis and an explicit input-ready handoff to opportunity-prioritization-and-frameworks. Do not describe ranking as forbidden by the user or as awaiting approval merely to calculate it. A provisional evidence-led comparison may be delivered, labelled as a recommendation, not an approved decision.
deployment-trigger-execution: Copy supplied rollback handle, immutable digest, target, authorization identity and run parameters into the proposal; never call a supplied rollback target missing. If mutable tag conflicts with an immutable digest, retain only the verified digest in the proposed action and list the conflict. Report missing full digest or workflow ref as explicit placeholders; do not fabricate them.
kubernetes-application-deployment: Build an authorization-to-action table linking the exact change ticket, approver, context, namespace, version and execution window. Preserve supplied previous revision and digest in rollback instructions, with verification after rollback. Never expand authorized clusters, namespaces or resource scope.
purposeful-motion-and-animation-engineer: When reduced motion disables transitions, commit final open/closed state synchronously; never wait for transitionend that will not fire. Restore focus after close. For animated mode handle interrupted transitions and ensure entrance start and end values differ. Assess flashing against the three-flashes-per-second safety threshold, including applicable area/luminance conditions; do not approve an unverified 4 Hz flash.
test-runtime-bootstrap: Use a minimal executable test with the exact behavior and expected value requested, not a trivial substitute. Verification must show at least one test ran and zero failures. Rollback restores config and lockfile plus dependency installation from that lockfile (for example npm ci), only under the same approved workspace scope.
website-audit-remediation: State unverified API and resource-type assumptions that the patch depends on; for missing image resources require a bounded nil guard or stop condition. Record independently observed out-of-scope defects in a separate handoff without repairing them or self-certifying the audit.
remote-pull-request-merge: Treat open/closed state as unknown unless explicitly present in current provider evidence. A heading such as MR state does not establish open state. Refresh that exact state before proposing a ready verdict; maintain SHA guard, merge method and no-branch-deletion authorization.
